detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

KPV (Lys-Pro-Val) (Aqueous Solution)

Chemical Information:

  • Molecular Formula: C₁₆H₃₀N₄O₄
  • Molecular Weight: 342.43 g/mol
  • Sequence: Lys-Pro-Val

Molecular Structure:

 

Product Description:

KPV is a synthetic tripeptide consisting of lysine, proline, and valine. This product is supplied as a pre-formulated aqueous research solution, designed to provide consistency and stability for controlled research applications. KPV is intended solely for in vitro laboratory research use by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:

  • Characterization of peptide structural properties in vitro
  • Analysis of peptide stability and degradation profiles
  • Evaluation of physicochemical properties of short-chain peptide compounds
  • Investigation of peptide behavior under controlled laboratory conditions
  • Analytical assessment of peptide consistency and composition

Storage and Handling:

  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration at 2–8 °C is recommended after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Maintain sterile handling practices during research use

Product Specifications:

  • Bottle Volume: 30 mL
  • Total Content: 40 mg per bottle
  • Dispenses per Container: ~200
  • Per Dispense: ~200 mcg
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.

Compliance Notice:

KPV (Lys-Pro-Val) (Aqueous Solution) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
